gates.requirement: Build, hashes, dependencies, policy/catalogue/knowledge pins and immutable package.
gates.reason: Preflight verifies all 2933 listed members, 924 production source bindings, package/lock dependency contracts and the actual c703 knowledge pin with 74 capabilities and 31 fragments. This is artifact integrity; npm-ci installation parity and operational adoption are not claimed.

gates.requirement: Page against isolated API/database; results and errors come from the actual API.
gates.reason: The UI/API/SQL R06 chain passes 20 checks on ai38-isolated-ui-api-sql. Its environment differs from linux_lab operation, so no operational UI/API acceptance is inherited.

gates.requirement: Ordinary owner/destination modules, super_admin, revoked access and exact human confirmation.
gates.reason: Actual isolated HTTP checks current authority and exact human confirmation, but no equivalent delivery acceptance ran against the operational laboratory API and its real authenticated shell.

gates.requirement: Leave/return, durable result and confirmed effects visible through native application reads.
gates.reason: One financial effect and leave/return work in disposable SQL. This does not attest natural-language creation, current operational app effects or replay behavior on the delivered operational runtime.

gates.requirement: Next turn uses the expected published context without rewriting an in-flight command or receipt.
gates.reason: The package has the new documentation-only c703 provenance pin. Neither this pin nor the isolated synthetic incompatible-admission/long-context regressions prove publishing a new real product and its next-turn use in linux_lab.

gates.requirement: Exact configured Web/Agentic selection and opt-in same-connection delegation; no fallback.
gates.reason: Fresh mode observations are non-generative: Web/Agentic available flags, MCP false and no verified modalities. One real canary in linux_lab_candidate_adapter made one dispatch, failed mcp_result_unknown without nonce, acknowledged terminal proof and made no replay. It did not adopt the candidate or verify Web-to-Agentic conversation/delegation in linux_lab.

gates.requirement: Each claimed MIME/model/mode has a real completed response on the delivered runtime.
gates.reason: No modality canary ran in AI38; both observed modes expose empty verified modality/media-type lists. Historical image/PDF/audio acceptance is not promoted to the current delivered runtime.

gates.requirement: Acceptance by published domain/capability; historical 4/7 is not acceptance on a new runtime.
gates.reason: Accumulated C05 history is still 4/7 with 77 remaining unpublished candidates. The failed transport nonce canary is not domain acceptance, and the isolated native writer/report regressions are not a model/MCP round trip.

gates.requirement: Per-environment immutable deployment, startup pins, drain, rollback and reconciliation runbook rehearsed.
gates.reason: The post-canary inventory preserves operational Node932, image061 and four active services; the new candidate is not adopted. Staging, a runbook and quiescent closure do not rehearse complete operational deployment/rollback. Cross-host skew is 383.66 seconds; guest NTP reports synchronized and independent HTTPS Date agrees with the guest while Windows Time is stopped. No clocks were changed, no total cross-host ordering or MCP timeout cause is inferred.

gates.requirement: Actual isolation, encrypted/rotated backups, trusted deletion journal, object/version inventory and restore reconciliation.
gates.reason: There is no AI38 environment evidence of continuous trusted deletion journal, encrypted backup rotation/expiration, all storage object versions and quarantine restore reconciled with current domain/native state. AI37 isolated restore and AI32 historical R2 tests retain their original scopes.

knowledge_provenance_note: The AI-37 addendum records a source_hash-only change, with identical approved content, capability contracts, bindings and fragments. A fresh build/package pin is required; no new knowledge approval or capability publication follows from that source-only hash change. Subsequent source changes must be classified from their actual diff.

boundaries.semantic_review: Checksums/context prevent accidental reassignment; they do not prove a producer is honest or its asserted success is semantically correct.
